creator: Mezmo
scope: The actual opening header navigation: four category dropdowns, Compact behavior and Phone menu. Existing terminal, its one default export and five controls remain separate and untouched.

localValidation.fixtureBoundary: Owned native-like DOM/system font and genuine inline14px p/span styles. This checks behavior/lifecycle/geometry, not actual Framer native font paint or context/ref bridge.

sourceContracts.animationTimingEvidence: Retained actual data-duration300/data-easing ease; first/150/550ms observations establish vertical entrance rather than a fitted independent timing curve.
sourceContracts.keyboard: Focus alone does not open Desktop group. Enter opens/toggles; ArrowDown admits its first native link. Escape closes selected group first, then Phone main menu. Outside source-menu clicks/taps dismiss it.

nativePlan.initialRecipeBoundary: The original 52-family recipe was applied. The actual MCP rejected codeOverride on the existing SVG, so one supported inert Frame host family was added. The unchanged SVG artwork remains inside that host.
nativePlan.finalOldSVGParentAdapter: The supported Frame host moves the old Primary SVG and resets only its left/top. The composed artwork rectangle and three inherited SVG bodies remain unchanged.

lifecycle.phoneMenu: At most one owned finite300ms WAAPI entrance/exit. Reduced/hidden/frozen/cleanup cancel or settle it.
lifecycle.resources: Scoped observers/listeners, callbacks and one menu effect clean up. Root caller styles and native refs remain preserved. No polling, scroll interception or shared terminal controller.

declaredFits: Desktop panel anchors retain original native label geometry and normalize any transformed owner scale. Existing authored labels differ slightly from source natural text boxes; source/native paint comparison remains a gate.
AURA genuine49x21 artwork is preserved inside the observed33.59375px Phone link linebox; tiny baseline alignment is a fit.
Source-relative destinations are normalized to their actual public source URLs, while Get started keeps source target_blank. No link was followed or submission made during authoring/tests.

verification.nixBoundary: Only drvPath was evaluated as wiring proof; no locked build execution claim. Exact same source/test already passed36 focused checks on the cached Nix toolchain.
verification.readbackBoundary: Actual native model and compiler readback through MCP598; this is not actual paint, Preview input or persistence after an editor reload.

pendingGates: Actual Desktop/Compact/Phone interactions and source font paint, body scroll chain, transformed placement, hidden/reduced/static behavior and editor reload.
Actual native Frame-host ref forwarding and Phone hit target in Framer Preview. Local native-like fixtures do not prove that bridge.
